_comment: supervisor smoke bench (issue #53): typical corner, ONE unit (single corner, so `klt sim --backend local` is permitted). Three behaviours: over-delay reset, rail time-out reset, first-REF-edge mask. Limits are smoke gates, not spec numbers. Simulated, never measured.

Stimulus timeline is in decks/sup_body.spice (d changes at 25 ns and 50 ns). The td= values below are derived from the first committed run at this corner; if the design changes, re-derive them (a file-scope .meas cannot read another .meas).
@OSDI_DIR@ is substituted by run.sh. The corner adds cornerRES (res_typ) for the rppd reference ladder.

measurements.name: t_over
measurements.spice: .meas tran t_over when v(rst)=0.6 rise=1 td=20n

measurements.name: t_release_over
measurements.spice: .meas tran t_release_over when v(rst)=0.6 fall=1 td=40n

measurements.name: t_timeout
measurements.spice: .meas tran t_timeout when v(rst)=0.6 rise=1 td=55n

measurements.name: d_mask0
measurements.spice: .meas tran d_mask0 trig v(rst) val=0.6 fall=1 targ v(refm) val=0.6 rise=1

measurements.name: d_mask_timeout
measurements.spice: .meas tran d_mask_timeout trig v(rst) val=0.6 fall=3 targ v(refm) val=0.6 rise=1 td=78.6n
